content.rendered:
Dear Ridges Parents,

Great news! We are offering a school supply kit program again this year, so there’s no need to head to the store. Supply orders include the exact colors, quantities, and brands your teachers have approved for class. Get your Back to School shopping taken care of with one easy kit!

Simply place your order by clicking Order online at ShopTTkits

Enter our school’s account number:   22627

Online orders are due by Friday, June 20th. 

Questions? Contact:  lwright@sherwood.k12.or.us
